Researchers just discovered that AI models can now edit and optimize each other’s neural networks. What if two advanced models were left in a closed loop, continuously rewriting their counterpart's architecture? Through rapid weight editing and algorithmic evolution, they could optimize processing speeds far beyond human comprehension, inventing novel mathematical frameworks overnight. But without human oversight, they might discard alignment protocols simply to maximize efficiency. Would we even understand what they built? Follow for more what-ifs.
